name: cli-session-write-back-buffer
body:
A live session buffers each admitted durable mutation as its node-file writes and deletes held in memory, and projects the change into the live `db.lbug` at admission. The on-disk node files and git history stay at their last saved state until a `save`, and each later mutation is built against the cumulative buffered state.

ACCEPTANCE:
- A sequence of accepted mutations leaves the on-disk `apg/layers/**` files and git history at their previous state, while a read routed through the session observes every buffered change.
- A mutation that updates or removes a node introduced earlier in the same unsaved run applies over the buffered state of that node.
